import inspect
from solution import check_last


def test_issue_example_5_7_10_p1_is_odd():
    """Example assert check_last([5,7,10],3,1) == "ODD"."""
    # expected copied verbatim from issue example: no arithmetic, result is "ODD"
    expected = "ODD"
    assert check_last([5, 7, 10], 3, 1) == expected


def test_contract_check_last_is_callable():
    """Public interface shows callable def check_last(arr, n, p)."""
    # expected truth value: callable True = 1 == 1
    expected = True
    assert callable(check_last) == expected


def test_contract_takes_three_parameters():
    """Public interface def check_last(arr, n, p) takes three parameters."""
    # arity: 1 (arr) + 1 (n) + 1 (p) = 3
    expected_count = 3
    assert len(inspect.signature(check_last).parameters) == expected_count


def test_contract_parameter_names_arr_n_p():
    """Public interface names parameters arr, n, p."""
    # names copied verbatim from `def check_last(arr, n, p)`
    expected_names = ["arr", "n", "p"]
    assert list(inspect.signature(check_last).parameters) == expected_names


def test_contract_returns_str_for_example():
    """Example returns string "ODD" so result must be str."""
    # expected type is str because issue example "ODD" is a str
    expected_type = str
    assert isinstance(check_last([5, 7, 10], 3, 1), expected_type)


def test_contract_result_is_uppercase():
    """Example "ODD" is uppercase so result must be uppercase."""
    # expected flag: "ODD".isupper() is True i.e. 1 == 1
    expected = True
    assert (check_last([5, 7, 10], 3, 1).isupper()) == expected


def test_contract_keyword_call_matches_positional():
    """Public interface allows call as check_last(arr, n, p)."""
    # both forms use same literals: [5,7,10], 3, 1 -> must agree
    assert check_last([5, 7, 10], 3, 1) == check_last(arr=[5, 7, 10], n=3, p=1)


def test_contract_zero_operations_returns_str():
    """Performing operation p times with p=0 must still return a string."""
    # expected type is str because even/odd answer is a string label
    expected_type = str
    assert isinstance(check_last([5, 7, 10], 3, 0), expected_type)


def test_contract_single_element_returns_str():
    """Given array with one element must still return a string."""
    # expected type is str; input list [2] has length 1 = 1
    expected_type = str
    assert isinstance(check_last([2], 1, 1), expected_type)


def test_contract_larger_p_returns_str():
    """Performing operation p times with larger p must still return a string."""
    # expected type is str; p used here: 1 + 4 = 5
    expected_type = str
    assert isinstance(check_last([5, 7, 10], 3, 5), expected_type)
